verdict.rationale: Hightouch's warehouse-native design means customer data, including collected events and identity-resolution outputs such as Golden Record tables, already lives in the customer's own warehouse and can be queried directly. That leaves little to export on exit, and independent community comments confirm Hightouch stores no data itself by default. Workspace configuration can also be managed through Git Sync and the REST API, but no explicit export or offboarding path is documented, and the format of exported configuration (models, audiences, journeys) is never stated. Missing for 10: documented export/offboarding flow for workspace configuration (audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning agents), explicit open-format specification, hands-on corroboration of a full exit.
